                        force_mag = min(mf * 0.5, 30.0 * dist)
                        ux, uy = (dx / dist, dy / dist) if dist > 1e-6 else (0, 0)
                        fx = force_mag * ux - 1.0 * vx
                        fy = force_mag * uy - 1.0 * vy
                        if abs(fx) > 24.0:
                            fx = 24.0 * (1 if fx > 0 else -1 if fx < 0 else 0)
                        if abs(fy) > 24.0:
                            fy = 24.0 * (1 if fy > 0 else -1 if fy < 0 else 0)
                        if speed > 0.03:
                            fx *= 0.5
                            fy *= 0.5
                        sandbox.apply_agent_force(fx, fy)
                        return
                else:
                    # Cooldown not done, wait
                    sandbox.apply_agent_force(-1.0 * vx, -1.0 * vy)
                    return

    # Default case: move towards next_switch
    tx, ty = _ZONE_CENTERS_FALLBACK[next_switch]
    dx = tx - x
    dy = ty - y
    dist = math.hypot(dx, dy)
    force_mag = min(mf * 0.5, 30.0 * dist)
    ux, uy = (dx / dist, dy / dist) if dist > 1e-6 else (0, 0)
    fx = force_mag * ux - 1.0 * vx
    fy = force_mag * uy - 1.0 * vy
    if abs(fx) > 24.0:
        fx = 24.0 * (1 if fx > 0 else -1 if fx < 0 else 0)
    if abs(fy) > 24.0:
        fy = 24.0 * (1 if fy > 0 else -1 if fy < 0 else 0)
    if speed > 0.03:
        fx *= 0.5
        fy *= 0.5
    sandbox.apply_agent_force(fx, fy)

def is_inside_zone(sandbox, x, y, zone_name):
    x_min, x_max, y_min, y_max = _ZONE_EXTENTS_FALLBACK[zone_name]
    return x_min <= x <= x_max and y_min <= y <= y_max
